findings.description: F003 declares a pure reconcile(registry, observed_canonical, now, policy) function, while F004 only says it loads observed canonical repos. No proposed feature pins the ledger-to-observed_canonical adapter that reads invocations.jsonl, ignores records without canonical_repo, aggregates count and max last_seen by canonical_repo_key, preserves scrubbed display, and proves command is never read.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit IO adapter contract between F002/F004 and F003: ledger records in, observed_canonical rows out, keyed by canonical_repo.path_key with count/max last_seen/path_display/durable_checkout only.

findings.description: F004 mixes two incompatible output expectations: JSON must contain scrubbed display plus counts only with no raw home path, but the tests also require a home-substituted projects add suggestion. If that suggestion appears in --json, C1 and the completion test fail; if it is human-only, the modality boundary is not pinned.
findings.recommendation: Pin the render matrix: --json never serializes reconstructed raw add paths, while human output may print locally reconstructed commands. Add separate JSON and human-output tests for all three C1 reconstruction cases.

findings.description: D010 says the durable DontPanic checkout was already registered, but the journey expects the p2a/p2-lock/main fixture to yield one used_unregistered candidate. Correct reconciliation would classify that same canonical repo as registered_active when the D010 registry state is present.
findings.recommendation: Pin the completion fixture registry state: test used_unregistered with DontPanic absent from the registry, and separately test registered_active with the D010-like registered state.

findings.description: F002 requires refusing any canonical mapping that cannot be confirmed, but the evidence contract does not define deterministic confirmation rules once temp worktrees are gone. Implementers could either guess from scrubbed evidence or over-skip valid historical rows, breaking the required one-time backfill.
findings.recommendation: Define the evidence validation matrix: allowed canonical_repo fields, how <home> displays are reconstructed for confirmation, how literal paths are checked, how non-reconstructable scrub tokens are skipped, and when path_key/origin_key mismatches become ambiguity.

findings.description: F002 acceptance says the local evidence file is excluded or ignored, but the steps do not name the ignore mechanism. Because DONTPANIC_HOME can be overridden during tests or local development, relying on ~/.dontpanic being outside the repo is weaker than the promised commit guard.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit ignore or exclude entry for repo-local .dontpanic/canonical-backfill-evidence.json and a small check or doc note proving the operator evidence file is never tracked.
